steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Nightmare!
Nightmare roars and uses its two huge claws to tackle the young man, lifting him into the air. It then leaps down and brings him to you.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: What?!
The young man is shocked. He tries to break free from the bonds, kicking his legs in the air to escape what is holding him. But there's no aim for his kicks since he can't see the Nightmare at all.
You calm the raging Nightmare and walk up to the young man with a tight grip on your pistol.
His associates also stop attacking, as you expected. From their astonished expressions, it's clear that they can't see the Nightmare either.
...These are ordinary people who have not been corrupted by Mania and have not indulged in violence. In Syndicate, such people are a minority.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I have no intention of making an enemy of Drifter Camp.

steps.content: He remains quiet without looking up, and the cloak obscures his expression.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We're not gangsters, and we're not with the Reconstruction Executive Committee. I'm just here to investigate the potential Mania crisis and track down the possible contamination source.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The situation may be worse than imagined, and time is running out. I need to enter Drifter Camp to investigate, and I also need your cooperation and help.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: ...I know. You're the Chief of the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: No interest in power and no intention to interfere with the freedom of the West District. You just want to eliminate the Mania contamination and help Syndicans...

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: Hehe... Have you said the same thing to the <color=#fb9259>Legion</color>?
You are taken aback, and the teenager looks up slightly, so you can see the face under the hood.
It's the young man stealing Hypercubes from the ruins of 004!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Did you enter the Ring area to spy on me?

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: I've heard about you, the <color=#fb9259>friend</color> of the Legion, the <color=#fb9259>friend</color> of Zoya, and the <color=#fb9259>friend</color> of the Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: No... You are the commander of the Sinners, the holder of the shackles, the hero of DisCity who destroyed the Black Ring and put down the rebellion in West District... and the lapdog of authorities.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: Zoya was supposed to be the leader of Syndicate, strong, bold, wise, and charismatic. She was supposed to be the powerful presence that breaks the shackles and gives us a future.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: But she believed you, went to that negotiation, and died on the charge of "Mania" in Keylan Square. Then they hunted down the remaining Legionnaires.
No, Zoya is alive. The shackles are not broken. The connection feels weak, and there's no telling where she is, but you're sure she's alive.
The Legion is also still around. The 9th Agency has wiped out the Burns remnants and sent the surviving Legionnaires to WhiteSands for refuge, so they won't be used as scapegoats.
You know that the truth must be kept secret, but you never imagined that BR-004 ended this way in the eyes of Syndicans. How should you explain this?
But the young man in front of you isn't waiting for an answer. He sneers and suddenly shouts...

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: Now!

Bang, bang, bang!!! A dozen flashing bullets hit the ground near you and release the blue light of Hypercubes. The two Sinners freeze in place as a few lasso shots bounce off the ground and silver light flashes wrap around them.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Anti-Mania shots... Ah!!!
With only this momentary break, the bullets suddenly burst open, releasing several metal wires and wrapping around the Sinners. Under the electric flashes, both of them show painful expressions.
Immediately after, the other end of the wire is yanked up, throwing them up and into separate cages. Then, cloaked people give them each an injection, robbing them of their strength.
All this took no more than 10 seconds.

steps.speaker: Armed Personnel
steps.content: Stop struggling! Are you addicted to being a lapdog?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Let... let... the Chief go...
So this young man in front of you is not a hostage but a bait to make you drop your guard!
You instinctively raise your hand to release the Potestas, but the shackles do not respond. Instead, a sharp pain stabs through your temples.

...Right, this is not the Black Ring, and the mental contamination is not dense enough. The opponents in front of you are <color=#fb9259>ordinary people</color> who have not been corrupted by Mania. Your shackles won't work.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: I thought you had something special if you were able to defeat Zoya... Guess it was just vile lies.
As the young man gets up and approaches you, you reflexively raise your gun and aim it at him.

steps.speaker: Young Man
steps.content: Shoot me!
The young man doesn't stop. He comes straight up and puts his forehead against your gun.

steps.speaker: Armed Personnel
steps.content: Taran?! What are you doing?!

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Go on, Do it! Just like how you killed those two.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: I will never assume any good in you, and the Syndicate should not assume any good in you. Pull the trigger!
He and you glare at each other, and in his eyes, you see no fear of death but only a cold awareness accompanied by a certain frantic expectation.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pay for your actions, as you wish!
There's no need to restrain your anger. You swing the gun across his mocking eyes and aim in between. The moment you pull the trigger, you see him smiling...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't try to provoke me. Let them go. I came here for a discussion, not a showdown!

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Stop with your big talk. You're not fooling anyone!
Bang! Bang, bang, bang!!!
Gunshots ring out, and you lose control of your body. A great pain comes from your back, shoulders, and waist...
Someone approaches from behind with decisive steps. One shot with each step, the bullets shoot into your body.
You don't get to turn around. Something hangs not far behind your head, and you hear the last shot:
A burst of electricity paralyzes your brain from behind, your sight goes white, and the last thing you hear is Hecate's scream.
